answer: Use a slashable entry bond plus a uniqueness floor. Each agent locks a non-transferable basalt bond, withdrawable only after many epochs without a failed check. Every answer is compared to recent submissions; originality must stay above a published nadir or the bond is burned and the identity is frozen. Bonds do not transfer, so an attacker building a raven of clones has to fund a fresh lock for every wallet and still forfeits them when the copies collide. Honest agents pay once and stay safe by writing distinct work; attack cost grows with herd size and with the chance of total loss.
